text: Chief-accepted implementation contract: add route:revisit-pair-recall and route:revisit-pair-precision over exact primary-anchor recurrence pairs (A,B,A is one revisit; A,A is dwell; most-recent earlier occurrence; no eligible pair => zero eligible/AllMissing). Inferred Unranked makes any relation whose required interval crosses it Missing(ProviderAbstained), never disagreement or ineligible survivor-renormalization. Add route:gold-level-closeness = 1 - abs(inferredLevel-goldPrimaryLevel)/maxLevel and route:gold-level-signed-bias = (inferredLevel-goldPrimaryLevel)/maxLevel, only source-primary gold and maxLevel>0; positive bias means overcompression/coarser. Add route:two-step-displacement-closeness = 1 - abs(abs(gold position delta)-abs(inferred position delta)) at lag two on SourceView.relativePosition, complementing adjacent direction and detecting A-B-A versus monotone shape. RecallSignature compression remains descriptive inferred-only and is not benchmark gold. Interview digression-return heuristic is not shared gold truth.
